sentences.text: Per contra, learned High Court Government Pleader would reiterate the various contentions urged in the statement of objections, and submits that, there is no merit in the petition and the same is liable to be dismissed.

It is however fairly submitted by the learned High Court Government Pleader that the concerned respondents would conduct a joint survey of the subject lands of the petitioners in the presence of the petitioners in order to ascertain whether any portion of the subject lands are being utilized for the purpose of formation of a road/highway by any of the respondents.
5. It is submitted that, pursuant to the said report being secured, the respondents would consider the representation submitted by the petitioners and proceed further in accordance with law.

6. In view of the aforesaid facts and circumstances, I deem it just and appropriate to dispose of this petition, directing the concerned respondents to conduct a joint inspection/survey report of the subject lands of the petitioner bearing Sy.No.517/3* measuring 3 acres 17 guntas, Sy.No.515/2*
